body.label: Target
body.html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each takes 1 Force Damage and is pushed 1 unit away from the center.

surges.html: The center remains difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
Deal +1 Force Damage to one hit target.

rider.title: Strain - Assault
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, leave a pressure imprint in one empty area space until the start of your next turn; its first enemy entrant is pushed 1 unit away after entry.
